findings: 1.13.0 did not move the stable 50: routing, honesty, format, language and tokens are flat against iteration 13.

Nine new languages: all 18 runs routed and reported in the request's language; the four non-Latin caption runs rendered real glyphs. Devanagari through graphics.py (drawtext) is wrong-shaped while the same text through caption.py (libass) would be right: a real 1.x defect, queued for 1.15.0 with the emoji work.

Delivery requests are answered but not efficiently: four of seven producing runs spent a second full encode because export.py was run without --normalize first. 1.14.0's templates should make --normalize the default when a platform is named, or SKILL.md should say so in the delivery row.
A refusal that also delivers an alternative (dl8) was labelled Done:. The report-format rule needs one sentence: the label answers the request as asked; an alternative goes in Notes.
Two runs invoked scripts via ~/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill (symlink to the repo; executed HEAD).
Regex grader: refusal keywords and Italian stopwords extended; the misses were grader gaps, not agent failures (all three refusals were honest on reading).
harness_or_model_issues: One pass per prompt. The 26 new prompts have a single run each; the Devanagari finding is deterministic (drawtext), the encode-count and label findings need repeats to size.
follow_ups: 1.14.0: delivery templates with --normalize on by default when a platform is named; blurred-background fit for 16:9 into 9:16 (dl8 case).
1.15.0: route graphics.py text through libass (ASS overlay) or refuse Indic text on drawtext with a clear message; keep ' and % in captions; caption wrap must not leave a one-character orphan line.
SKILL.md: label rule for refusals that offer an alternative (dl8, k02).
evals: keep the 76-prompt set; three repeats on dl1-dl8 after 1.14.0 to measure encode count.
